chapters.title: Episode 1: Arrival
chapters.content:
The rain stopped as Hana reached the gate.

She read the faded sign and stepped inside.

chapters.title: Episode 2: Shift
chapters.content:
By dawn the old map had changed its marks.

Each line now pointed toward the river road.

chapters.title: Episode 3: Decision
chapters.content:
The council waited in silence for her final word.

Hana chose the northern route and sealed the pact.
